extract_fields.Variety: the full variety name over-printed on the label (near the GGN / PUC / Lot no.), copied exactly as printed -- include BOTH the code name and any trade name in brackets, plus any ®/™ symbol, e.g. 'SUGRANINETEEN (SCARLOTTA SEEDLESS®)' or 'CRIMSON SEEDLESS'. Never return just the part in brackets
extract_fields.GGN: the 13-digit GGN number printed on the label
extract_fields.LotNumber: the lot/batch code printed on the label (e.g. 'L36-04')
extract_fields.VarietyGroup: the produce variety group / commodity name printed on the label (e.g. 'White Seedless Grapes')

text_blocks.Variety Group languages: the pre-printed block of text listing this product's name translated into approximately 23 different European languages (e.g. 'Trauben rot, kernlos / Seedless Red Grapes / Raisin rosé sans pépin / ...') -- NOT the 'South Africa' country translations or the net weight translations

logo_checks.name: QR code
logo_checks.description: a square 2D QR code -- a matrix of small black squares with three larger square position markers in its corners (often with 'PPWR' printed in or beside it). NOT the ordinary 1D striped/linear barcode
